en_US: Have you ever seen Clair’s signature
Pokémon? It’s a wonder to marvel at!
I’d love for my Horsea to match that
Pokémon, but it isn’t strong enough...
Say, you’re a Trainer, right? You might
find this item more useful than me.
There was this move I just had
to teach my Pokémon.
So I got the Move Deleter to make it
forget an HM move.
They say that the Pokémon Mart here
got ahold of a large shipment of rare
evolution stones.
That item is said to do something if
used on a Seadra...
Evolution is so cool!
It’ll make your opponents drool!
Since evolution is so cool,
I’ll give you a cool item!
Come back tomorrow for
something even cooler!
